content.summary: The residual proof hypotheses are constructed from actual families rather than assumed search profiles, and the outsider-cap proof is noncircular. The revised Section 6 accurately separates external enumeration in Corollary 4 from exploratory computations unused by local proofs. No method or assurance repair is required in this phase.

checks.scope: Actual-family residual hypotheses and noncircular outsider cap
checks.method: Read frozen ProfileABridge.lean, the ResidualProfileA structure and derived lemmas, ProfileAOutside.lean, and TwoStarResidual.lean. Trace the order of obligations and their uses.
checks.observation: The bridge sets H to the family omitting x and O to the support outside x and its link. It derives |H|=61, |O|=4, outsider degree19 and interior degree≤14 by a degree partition. Outsider≤2 is not a structure field: it follows from an independently proved disjoint partner and the twenty-link transversal bound. H2 intersecting is then derived before I27 is applied. In the two-star proof, independence supplies y outside the first link and makes the y-star avoid x; a hypothesized small trace would make a four-element transversal of the other link. No conclusion is used as a hidden premise.

checks.scope: External enumeration versus local exploratory methods
checks.method: Compare the exact round-three-to-four manuscript change with Theorem 2, Theorem 3, Corollary 4 and the previously directly checked external-source scope.
checks.observation: Section 6 now expressly states that the ordinary corollary uses external enumerative I27, while the listed diagnostic, failed witness attempt and UNKNOWN SAT run are not local proof premises. This removes the earlier potential overbroad reading that every successful conclusion was enumeration-free. The text still claims neither independent human certification nor universal45.
